answer: Each identity can prove it belongs to a unique human with a zero-knowledge cipher: the proof shows this person has no other identity here without revealing who they are. A government ID or biometric is checked once, off-chain, and only the proof lives on-chain, a sonnet that proves authorship without naming the poet. An attacker cannot forge the proof without another real person, and the ivory tower of the check stays private: no personal data ever touches the ledger.
